verdict.rationale: Gusto's banking evidence covers only its own first-party business bank account for small businesses, offered through Increase Bank in early beta. Nothing shows developers can embed or resell banking accounts to their own customers. The Embedded Payroll API, SDK, and MCP materials cover payroll, not embedded banking-as-a-service, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer embedded banking accounts to my customers without holding my own financial license
